kind: APPROVED STAGE1 DOCUMENTATION ONLY; no accession pilot
selection: One primary official API field-documentation page already cited by the project. Eight is an upper bound, not a request quota. Do not fetch known large manuals under this64KiBread cap or invent replacement URLs.
scope: Official documentation definitions only, not issuers or financial observations. No real benchmark, filing body/header/index, 48-item roster, source correction, price, return, sealed data, model or trial-ledger append.

HTTP_contract.read_cap_boundary: Conservative: body reaching64KiB is unqualified; do not read an extra byte or call it complete.

receipt_semantics: Append-only started/finished events. Charge the ignored historical counter before sending. Status and SHA256 refer to observed bytes; an unread error response has zero observed bytes, not a full-body hash. Crash/unfinished attempts require review, never automatic resume.
stop: Any redirect, non2xx,403,429,5xx,transport/deadline,read cap,unsupported encoding,scope/budget failure. No alternate identity/header/proxy or replacement URL. If the complete document is unclear, blocked or a JS shell, report the gap. No accession pilot follows without a new decision.
review: Record short exact field definitions only, with retrieval/version applicability separate from any clock guarantee. General business hours or Z syntax does not certify historical JSON/header/index clock accuracy. No automatic qualification.
adapter_negative_tests: Must pass and be committed before live request; final full-suite result is reported separately after both parts.
